description.value: The Gibsons & District Aquatic Facility is a publicly operated swimming and aquatics centre run by the Sunshine Coast Regional District, serving the Gibsons community on BC's Sunshine Coast. It sits on Gibsons Way and offers swimming programs alongside broader aquatic recreation. For touring cyclists arriving by ferry from Vancouver, it represents a convenient stop for a swim after a day on the saddle.

enrichment_extras.reasoning: The website content consists almost entirely of repeated SCRD navigation menus with no facility-specific amenity descriptions; the fetched pages confirm the facility is real and actively listed under SCRD's Facilities section as 'Gibsons & District Aquatic Facility,' but provide no textual evidence for bike parking, showers, washrooms, or any other amenity. The OSM name 'Gibsons Swimming Pool' differs from the website's consistent use of 'Gibsons & District Aquatic Facility,' which is worth flagging. All amenity fields are set to null due to absence of supporting evidence in the available content.
concerns: Name mismatch: OSM uses 'Gibsons Swimming Pool' but the SCRD website consistently refers to this facility as 'Gibsons & District Aquatic Facility.' OSM name retained per rules.
Website content only returned navigation menus; no facility-specific amenity details could be extracted. All amenity fields are unverified.
enrichment_extras.recommended_status_reason: A real, publicly accessible aquatic facility actively listed on the SCRD website; useful to touring cyclists seeking a swim or shower stop in Gibsons.
